title: corydalis bracteosa
intro: Corydalis bracteosa, commonly known as the 'Golden Corydalis' or 'Chinese Corydalis', is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Papaveraceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including anxiety, insomnia, and pain. The therapeutic actions of Corydalis bracteosa include promoting relaxation, reducing inflammation, and alleviating pain, making it a popular ingredient in traditional Chinese medicine.
